raw_text: Pakistan-Based Bot Network Floods Social Media with Anti-India Kashmir Content. Indian intelligence agencies have flagged a coordinated inauthentic behavior campaign traced to Pakistani IP ranges that activated thousands of bot accounts on the fifth anniversary of Article 370 abrogation. The network pushed fabricated atrocity images, many reverse-traced to older conflicts in Syria and Palestine, while tagging international human rights organizations to demand intervention in Kashmir.
